description:
Short episodes featuring Mega Evolution Pokémon released on the Pokémon Official YouTube Channel.

Episodes:
#1 Bonding with Kangaskhan / Mega Hanasenai ne Garura (めがはなせないね ガルーラ), released October 3, 2025.
#2 Tomorrow with Gardevoir / Ashita mo Sirknight to (明日もサーナイトと), released October 24, 2025.
#3 Sing! Dance! Altaria! / Utau! Odoru! Tyltalis! (うたう！おどる！チルタリス！), released February 13, 2026.
